A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the Study here presented proposes a metric that can be used in the analysis of the knowledge management capability of organizations, and that can be used to estimate the possible relationships existing between the efficiency of a knowledge management system and its business performances; such metric is here tested on two different samples of private technology consulting and public administration firms and it is proved to be a useful instrument for estimating the real divide existing in such organizations and for proposing a suitable strategy for improving their knowledge management system.
the Study proposes to extend the knowledge audit models by adding a specific assessment process of knowledge management capabilities.

the Study's main contribution consists in the development of a specific knowledge audit metric whose application is here proved to be able to produce a reliable estimate of the effectiveness of the organization's knowledge management systems, in particular of the knowledge management support provided by the organization's technology and of the related improvements achievable in terms of technology by taking specific interventions on some of the system's main constituting elements.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the knowledge audit metric here proposed is not only able to assess the effectiveness of the organization's knowledge management system, but it also allows to individuating those interventions that can boost the capabilities of such system, and thus improve the business performances of such organization.

a specific assessment process of knowledge management capabilities can be structured by applying a specific grid that allows to estimate the possible relationships existing among the efficiency of the Knowledge Management System, its support level to the organization's Intellectual Capital, the improvements achievable by taking a change in some of the constituting components and the increases in the organization's business performances.
